findings.title: The Trained Predator Holds for Another
findings.claim: In the local legal sequence, predatory force becomes a lawful handoff when a trained hunting creature captures and holds food for the human recipient rather than consuming it itself.
findings.mechanism: The pericope places hunting under covenantal and bounded permission, names trained hunting creatures and their handlers, and then directs the people to eat what those creatures hold. The focus branches for capture, predatory animals, training, holding, and eating therefore explain one another as delegated capture ending in another's reception.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the focus permission as a transfer of controlled force into human reception, not only as a list of permitted objects.
findings.containment: This is a pericope-bounded relation among hunting, training, holding, and eating. It does not claim that every animal, every capture, or every use of the roots has this delegated structure.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel supports are landed through exact focus and pericope occurrences, and the cited connections supply the surrounding hunting and lawful-food frame.

findings.containment: The finding is limited to the supplied remembrance occurrences and the focus's naming command. It does not claim that every root occurrence has the same branch or that the focus is a citation of 5:7 or 5:11.

epistemic.reason: Exact focus and pericope remembrance occurrences support both verbal-anma and God-directed remembrance facets.

findings.title: Permission With a Guard
findings.claim: The focus's final command to guard oneself makes permitted appetite part of a repeated pericope pattern in which action is placed behind a protective boundary against wrongdoing.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries the self-guarding form at 5:4:26:2, and the same root returns at 5:2:41, 5:7:13, 5:8:19, and 5:11:18 beside non-transgression, covenant remembrance, justice, and restrained hands. Repetition contacts the focus command with the passage's protective limit on action.
findings.reader_payoff: Permission is newly perceptible as accompanied by an active guard, so the closing caution governs how the appetite is exercised.
findings.containment: This is a repeated pericope relation, not a claim that all taqwa occurrences are interchangeable or that the focus's legal details are replaced by a general moral theme.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies exact focus and repeated pericope occurrences, with connections explicitly identifying the boundary and restraint frame.

findings.title: Teaching Within the Created World
findings.claim: The external Fatiha overlay makes the focus's chain of divine teaching, human training, and animal learning perceptible against a named world of created classes, while the immediate focus remains trained hunting.
findings.mechanism: The external form عَٰلَمِينَ at 1:2:4 carries the created-world branch, and the focus form عَلَّمَكُمُ at 5:4:16:1 supplies the independent teaching contact. Their shared root adds a bounded created-world horizon to the focus's instruction chain after the native pericope has already established its legal hunting frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can notice that the focus's transfer of teaching reaches living creatures within a wider created order, without losing the concrete food ruling.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory external overlay, not a claim that the focus teaching word literally means worlds and not a whole-surah theme. The contact is limited to 1:2:4 returning through the focus teaching form.

epistemic.reason: Phase 2 supplies an exact external root occurrence and an exact focus return, but no external connection row or candidate nomination establishes more than this bounded overlay.
